decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed within 3 months of the date of approval.
Condition : 2 - The extract duct hereby approved shall be completed in the materials specified on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (APL-004-03 received 13/05/2013 and APL-001, APL-002, APL-003, Design & Access Statement received 21/03/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for a B2 joinery workshop shall not be carried on outside the following times: Monday-Friday 8am-6pm and Saturday 8am-1pm.

Condition : 6 - The rating level of noise emitted from the premises shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The levels shall be determined according to BS4142:1997.
Condition : 7 - The scheme of extract ventilation shown on the approved drawings shall be maintained in good working order in accordance with the manufacturer's technical specifications.
description: Change of use from storage to joinery workshop and installation of extraction duct terminal to roof
